integrity: An explicit digit-addition and parity-transition recurrence is reduced to a finite nondeterministic automaton with 864 reachable states. Its terminal least fixed point and full 1302-state determinization yield an output-mask invariant for every finite difference-bit input, furnishing an all-difference proof. The independent direct-prefix check for differences 1 through 128 is secondary.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to five sampled positions of the original binary Rudin–Shapiro sequence at a positive fixed difference. Does not determine frequency of occurring patterns or analogous exact support for six or more terms. Unindexed exact fixed-difference support calculations remain an originality risk.
title: Five-term Rudin–Shapiro arithmetic factors: an exact fixed-difference dichotomy
